notes.title: 🛠️ Devlog #2 - Demo Update Patch – Post Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
[h1]👋Hello, pilots![/h1]
Thanks to everyone who tried out the [b]Acrodrift Demo[/b] during Steam Next Fest! Your feedback has been incredibly helpful and motivating. We’ve prepared a patch to address several early issues and improve the overall experience.

If you haven’t filled out our feedback survey yet, you can still do it here: [url=https://forms.gle/aoFv4FPS7H6EivTo8]Take the survey[/url]

[h1]✨ What's New & Improved[/h1]

[h2]Editable Official Drone Presets[/h2]
Official drone setups now have an ✏️ “Edit” button. It creates an editable copy, leaving the original configuration untouched.

[h2]Improved drone list performance[/h2]
Optimized the drone list to prepare for the addition of many new drones in the future.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601728/9b30ae29e6a06ff3a6b5a25854c1419624620895.png[/img]

[h2]Gamepad Button Rebinding[/h2]
You can now rebind gamepad buttons to custom in-game actions directly from the settings menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601728/f5b8689a8d20be39817f8826d43a61efdaa317ec.png[/img]

[h2]"All Devices" Option[/h2]
Added a new setting to allow input from multiple devices simultaneously. Note: Make sure your devices use different axis numbers to avoid conflicts.

[h2]Adjusted Drone Gravity[/h2]
Slightly increased drone gravity for a more grounded and responsive flight feel.

[h1]💬 Join the Community[/h1]

We're excited to announce that we've launched the official Acrodrift Discord server!

Come join us to:
[list]
[*] Share your feedback and ideas 💡
[*] Report bugs 👾
[*] Get help from other pilots 🤝
[*] Connect with other FPV pilots and fans of drone racing 🏁
[/list]
[h3]👉 [url=https://discord.gg/E9EmXjKway]Join the Discord[/url] 👈[/h3]

[h1]🫶🏻 Add Acrodrift to Your Wishlist[/h1]

Every addition to the Steam wishlist greatly motivates us and helps us reach more players like you, eagerly awaiting a realistic FPV simulator. Click today to stay updated with all the latest news!

Thank you for your support, and see you soon in the air!

Best regards,
Dueking Studio

notes.title: Devlog #1 – Acrodrift FPV Drone Simulator Approaching Demo Release!
notes.content:
[h1]👋 Hello Everyone![/h1]

I'm a developer at Dueking Studio, working on Acrodrift, a unique FPV drone flying simulator. My passion for FPV drones and electronics transformed what began as a small hobby project into an advanced FPV drone simulation, accurately modeling physics based on real flight controllers!

The project is already at an advanced stage, and we are extremely excited to finally share it with a wider audience.

[h1]🌄 Maps[/h1]

We have prepared several maps, and in this devlog, we'd like to showcase the Container Port map, which will be available in the demo version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601728/437980feb35d4cbd3bd360161fc8fdce1beec5d7.png[/img]
The Container Port offers a rich environment filled with tall cranes, container stacks, warehouses, and docked ships. It's an ideal place to test your skills in navigating obstacles, sharp turns, and large structures of varying heights.

We eagerly await your feedback and suggestions on the map, as well as ideas for future locations!

[h1]🎮 Controls[/h1]

To fly an FPV drone in Acrodrift, you'll need a Gamepad or a Radio Controller.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601728/3a3f9fe1afb60b1fdf0424303ab13f6b5f938e9c.png[/img]

Flying with a Radio Controller is easier and more realistic, so we especially recommend this method.

[h1]📅 What's Next?[/h1]

In the next few days, you can expect the release of the demo version! You'll experience firsthand the thrill of FPV drone flying and see for yourself how accurately we've replicated reality.

[h1]💬 Your Opinion Matters![/h1]

We'd love to hear from you – on which platforms would you most like to play our simulator? [b]Comment below![/b]

[h1]🫶🏻 Add Acrodrift to Your Wishlist[/h1]

Every addition to the Steam wishlist greatly motivates us and helps us reach more players like you, eagerly awaiting a realistic FPV simulator. Click today to stay updated with all the latest news!

Thank you for your support, and see you soon in the air!

Best regards,
Dueking Studio
